description: What an ordinary Defender log holds without any detection: 5007, a configuration change, hundreds of which were measured on every machine in ADR 0059, and 5000, real-time protection enabled. Both differ from the selector only in the event id. The last group is the same id from another provider on another channel: an event id means something only with its provider and channel (ADR 0031). That provider and channel are illustrative, not measured, and the counts and times here are illustrative unless the text above says they were measured.
